message.content:
**When the pain and shortness of breath started**  
The pain and the shortness of breath began last night, right after the catheter that I keep in my urinary pouch stopped working. It’s been getting worse ever since.

**How the pain feels**  
It’s a very strong, steady pain in the lower part of my belly. It feels more like a deep pressure or ache rather than a cramp, and it hasn’t gone away. It stays in the lower abdomen and doesn’t really radiate to other places.

**What kind of catheter I was using**  
I have an indwelling catheter that sits inside my continent MAINZ pouch (the urinary diversion I have after my bladder surgery). It’s meant to stay in continuously so the pouch can drain urine.

**What happened when the drainage “failed”**  
Last night the catheter stopped draining. I noticed that the amount of urine coming out dropped a lot – almost nothing was coming out at all. It felt like the tube was blocked, because the pouch wasn’t emptying the way it usually does. That is when the severe belly pain and the shortness of breath started.
